text:
sam: deploy-bot flagged the promotion to eu-west-prod — postupgrade hook failed during CRD validation after chart update 2.4.0 -> 2.5.0. Looks like a schema bump in the chart templates. can we pin the chart on the promotion pipeline to unblock?

deploy-bot: promotion paused for release/rule-214 — reason: postupgrade-hook failed (crd-validation). logs: /var/log/deploy/release-214/postupgrade.log — see summary below.

nina: do we know if this is values drift or an actual chart/template change? quick decision: rollback or pin?

sam: not values — chart introduced a CRD schema change (added `.metadata.annotations.v2` expectation for controller). helm upgrade triggers our validation in the postupgrade job and it fails. short-term options: pin chart version to 2.4.0 in the deploy pipeline OR run the migration job manually before promoting 2.5.0. Example pin command: `helm upgrade mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace eu-west-prod --version 2.4.0 --set image.tag=sha@digest`

alex: if we pin, let's also create a hotfix branch for the chart migration and add clear release notes. we should schedule a change window for the pin/rollback so teams know not to re-promote during that window.

leah: I'll open a manual PR to pin the chart in the release-promotion repo and propose a window. proposed window: today 15:00-16:00 UTC. any objections? :clock3:

maria: no objections, but note that 2.5.0 includes a DB migration step in the chart's postupgrade job. before unpinning we'll need a canary run of the migration in staging and then a monitored staging->prod rollout. suggested quick migration-runner command: ```kubectl apply -f charts/mysvc/migration-job.yaml --namespace staging && kubectl logs -f job/mysvc-migration -n staging``` monitor for ~30m.

ops-bot: PR created: release-promotion#458 — pin chart to 2.4.0 — author: leah — https://github.com/redwood/release-promotion/pull/458

nina: :thumbsup: pin sounds right. please add a line in the release notes stating reason (CRD schema bump) and next steps to re-promote after migration verified.

sam: plan: 1) merge pin PR (leah) 2) cancel the current promotion to eu-west-prod and requeue after pin 3) create a tracking issue for the migration + rollback-of-pin 4) post release notes in the release channel and alert SRE during change window. pin merge will run this helm command on the promotion agent: `helm upgrade mysvc ./charts/mysvc --namespace eu-west-prod --version 2.4.0`

deploy-bot: promotion canceled for eu-west-prod (release/rule-214) — moved to hold queue — TTL 2h.

alex: please paste the exact failing log snippet in the tracking issue so we can triage the controller change.

sam: failing log snippet: ```ERROR: CRD validation failed: field "+metadata.annotations.v2" not found in current CR schema. stack: ValidationError(CustomResource): invalid object: missing required property 'metadata.annotations.v2' at /spec/template/metadata/annotations```

leah: I'll add the migration steps to the release notes template and tag SRE for monitoring in the proposed window. I'll also put a short runbook: if postupgrade-hook errors after unpinning, immediate action = rollback via `helm rollback <release> 1` and open on-call paged incident.

sam: merging the pin PR now, will follow up with the tracking issue and a short release-notes entry. :shipit:
